senses.gloss:
चङ्कुण चङ्कुण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
चक्), a carriage, a tree; (अम्), n. any vehicle.

चङ्क्रमण चङ्क्रमण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens.
of rt. क्रम्), going about, taking exercise; who or
what goes slowly or crookedly; (अम्), n. going about,
walking, proceeding, going tortuously or slowly.

चङ्क्रमा, f. going about, walking, going tor-
tuously or slowly.
—चङ्क्रमा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
who or what moves slowly or crookedly.

चाङ्ग चाङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. चङ्ग), wood-sorrel;
whiteness or beauty of the teeth.

चाङ्गेरी, f. wood-sorrel, Oxalis Pusilla; [cf. कु-
चाङ्गेरी.]
